## Verification

List exact commands/manual checks actually run, results and evidence. Explain blocked checks. Do not claim CI, preview or deployment exists unless verified.

For UI work, include browser/viewport observations and safe screenshots. For behavior/security changes, include relevant negative and failure cases.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria met; no unrelated features/dependencies.
- [ ] Applicable AGENTS.md and milestone constraints followed.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, private media links, uploads or backups in diff/artifacts.
- [ ] Relevant validation/auth/failure checks included where applicable.
- [ ] Applicable existing quality gates pass, or blockers are explicitly stated.
- [ ] Docs/env examples and migration/recovery guidance updated when needed.
- [ ] Complete diff manually reviewed, including author/commit trailers.

## Risks, limitations and handoff

State unresolved risks, actual ledger status and proposed next issue. Merge/deploy and next milestone are not automatically authorized by this PR.
